listing.name: Urban Reign (Urban Reign Recomp)
listing.summary: Attach an independently permitted, prepared Urban Reign Windows native game with its exact USA disc executable and explicit ISO path. Preserve executable-side settings, memory cards and states; the browser launcher, optional HD packs and multiplayer claims retain separate scope.

steps.title: Prepare the exact supported original upstream
steps.instruction: Use a complete player/components you are independently permitted to use, with your own Urban Reign PS2 USA SLUS-21209 ISO. Source requires SYSTEM.CNF to boot SLUS_212.09 and checks that ELF’s SHA256 60399090fc69ffdb4c39afd30977ab50890b0e33ed6bd9374e4d9497f4246081. This is an executable/revision contract, not a whole-ISO cryptographic fingerprint or other-region admission. Finish the upstream disc and settings flow first, preserving independent originals. No disc, BIOS, importer, helper, compiler, mod or game is obtained or executed here.

steps.title: Keep the complete Windows player unit
steps.instruction: The inspected official 1.4.1 Windows ZIP contains AMD64 Urban Reign.exe and game/urban.exe with the matching PS2Recomp/PCSX2 renderer and runtime libraries, resources and notices. Keep the entire UrbanReignPC-1.4.1 package. The outer launcher and native game have distinct roles; Linux .deb/tar and their GTK/WebKit route are separate artifacts, not qualified by this Windows inspection.

steps.title: Attach the explicit native game command
steps.instruction: Select game/urban.exe and use its complete game/ directory as working directory. Set --iso followed by the quoted absolute path to your already prepared supported ISO. Use the actual original path, not a literal placeholder, and keep that file in place. Review the intent and request Play separately. Source mounts and verifies that ISO, prepares its local game_data cache and runs the linked native game in the selected process. Do not attach the outer browser launcher and assume its child lifetime, add --write-settings as Play or substitute a generated ELF/module DLL.

steps.title: Preserve the actual executable-side player roots
steps.instruction: Normally keep game/config.ini, controls.ini, memcards/mc0/, states/quick.state, game_data/ including derived disc/cache data, mods/, textures/ and the selected ISO. Source defaults writable data to urban.exe’s directory; an established URBAN_USER_DIR chooses another root, URBAN_MC_DIR can select external cards and an explicit quick-state path remains authoritative. Older config/control files can be converted with retained copies; keep all old/new roots and actual paths. Memory-card saves and whole-runtime states differ; do not merge other revisions. This guide performs no import, conversion, backup, restore, migration or deletion.

steps.title: Retain optional-content and replacement ownership
steps.instruction: Keep project GPLv3, PS2Recomp/PCSX2, SDL and all component notices. They do not license the original Namco game, separate HD texture packs or third-party DLL mods; use only a complete copy/content you are independently permitted to use. The included CoopTool is a separate optional gameplay surface, not an eight-player or physical-controller observation. Quit the game normally before upstream replacement or data work, retain independent recovery and review/relink changed bytes. No native/installed, multiplayer, hardware, gameplay, real-save or Supported acceptance is asserted. Registration removal preserves external files; managed lifecycle operations remain unavailable.

warnings: Select the native game/urban.exe with the real supported ISO path and preserve its actual card/state roots. Browser-launcher tracking and optional packs/multiplayer remain separate.
